# Citizens Review Archive

> Public archival case documentation for the standard citizens review project files.

## Case Files
- [SD68 Bailey Case 001](https://5hw280543.github.io/citizens-review-archive/sd68/bailey-001.html): Transcript and archival documentation for Naomi Bailey file.
- [Ladysmith Harbour Case 001](https://5hw280543.github.io/citizens-review-archive/ladysmith/Harbour-001.html): Government documentation and wastewater analysis for Ladysmith file.
